description: Known issues baseline for L0-L2 deployment audit (Domain 6 input). Issues are maintained externally from the audit design document to avoid hardcoding.

issues.title: VERSION_REGISTRY format mismatch between writers
issues.description: integration-helpers.ts writes VERSION_REGISTRY variants as a flat array (VersionRegistryEntry[]). validate-templates.ts reads variants as a nested object keyed by name (Record<string, Record<string, unknown>>). Running integration-helpers.ts against the current file would corrupt the structure by replacing the nested object with an array.

issues.title: common.lifecycle.json missing co-deck and co-game from propagatedTo
issues.description: The propagatedTo array contains only 5 variants (co-develop, co-work, co-design, co-security, co-consult). co-deck and co-game are missing despite existing as beta variants in templates/.

issues.title: create-l2-scaffold.ts contains markdown fencing artifact on line 2
issues.description: Line 2 contains triple backticks followed by 'typescript' (```typescript). This is a spurious markdown code fence opener baked into the script file. It does not affect bun runtime execution but indicates an accidental artifact from documentation.

issues.title: deploy-to-l1.ts referenced in ADR-0040 but never implemented
issues.description: ADR-0040 defines a dedicated deploy-to-l1.ts for CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, and agents/pm.md L0-to-L1 deployment with section filtering and CONSTITUTION.md reference transforms. The script has never been created. Governance deployment currently relies on propagate-to-templates.ts --governance-l1.

issues.title: No rollback mechanism for L0-to-L1 propagation
issues.description: propagate-to-templates.ts copies files from L0 to L1 without creating backups before writing. The --force flag always overwrites without confirmation. There is no transaction mechanism or snapshot-based rollback capability. If propagation fails mid-way, partially-written files remain.

issues.title: Variant Registry Architecture design document status is 'Proposed' despite implementation
issues.description: The variant-registry architecture design document (5-layer architecture: SSOT Data, Procedural Behavior, Validation Rules, Workspace Integration, Pipeline) has status 'Proposed'. However, the following have been implemented: registries/ directory (4 files), plugins/ directory (3 files), validators/ directory (7+ files), and workspace-integration.ts. Status should be updated to reflect implementation progress.

issues.title: L2 variants cannot auto-sync with L1 improvements (by-design per ADR-0031)
issues.description: ADR-0031 Fork Model Principle 2 intentionally prohibits automatic L1-to-L2 propagation after scaffold-time delivery. L2 variants can fall silently behind L1 improvements. The --check-drift flag provides read-only visibility but no remediation automation. This is an accepted architectural trade-off documented in the ADR.

issues.title: Unreferenced propagation-map.json duplicates under templates/common/
issues.description: Two L1 copies of propagation-map.json existed. The bare templates/common/propagation-map.json had zero readers anywhere in the repo (all code resolves scripts/propagation-map.json relative to process.cwd()) and was deleted on 2026-09-04; new-project.ts's WORKSPACE_ONLY_FILES entry for it was removed at the same time. The remaining copy at templates/common/scripts/propagation-map.json is kept in sync via the propagation-map self-propagation domain added 2026-09-04 and is byte-identical to the L0 SSOT (modulo line endings): the CONSTITUTION.md scrub used to corrupt its functional JSON field values (constitution-context source_file read as "context.md") until T-20260912-005 exempted .json from the scrub, and the byte-parity claim was unenforced until validate-templates.ts v1.25.0 extended checkL0L1ScriptParity's glob fallback to .json files. Nothing reads the L1 copy's content; removing it requires adding propagation-map.json to the L0-only exception list first.

issues.title: VERSION_MANIFEST date-column off-by-one-commit lag fails full-history CI
issues.description: The manifest's Last Modified cells derive from committed git log, but dev-sync generates the manifest (step 4.7) before committing (step 6), so the committed manifest records the pre-PR date for every file the PR touches. CI merge previews regenerate with the PR commit as last toucher, so date cells drift by one commit whenever the previous toucher predates the PR's day. PR #954's first CI run failed on this (2026-09-18); recovery required the convergence commit eb6901ab. Date masking currently applies to shallow checkouts only (T-20260916-013). Remediation: ADR-0081 Decision 1 / T-20260918-001 — mask Last Modified columns in full-history mode too.

issues.title: No sanctioned path to conclude a conflicted merge on an open PR branch
issues.description: When origin/main advances while a PR branch is open, the shared pipeline files (CHANGELOG.md, memory/MEMORY.md, docs/VERSION_MANIFEST.md, generated READMEs) conflict per CONSTITUTION §3.3, and a conflicted merge cannot be concluded locally: bare git commit is rejected by the pre-commit SYNC_ACTIVE gate and dev-sync refuses while MERGE_HEAD exists. Recovery requires a full branch rebuild (resolve, reset --hard origin/main, replay the resolved tree, re-run dev-sync, push --force-with-lease) — observed on PR #954 (2026-09-18). Remediation: ADR-0081 Decision 2 / T-20260918-002 — pre-flight main-drift warning plus a sanctioned dev-sync --conclude-merge mode running the standard gate battery.

issues.title: Intentional-duplicate parity unit test pins absolute marker line numbers
issues.description: The scanner-parity test asserts the §3 marker in templates/common/docs/context.md at an absolute line (421, re-pinned to 429 on 2026-09-18) and variant.context.template.md at 151, so any upstream insertion — including docs-only changes — breaks CI on all OSes (observed on PR #955, 2026-09-18). Marker position is incidental; identity (file/section/source/hash) is the contract. Remediation: ADR-0081 Decision 3 / T-20260918-003 — assert marker identity and drop absolute line expectations.

issues.title: Fleet (Projects/co-*) receives policy-class L1 changes only via manual resync
issues.location: templates/common/docs/context.md (COMMON-CONTEXT block), templates/common/AGENTS.md (COMMON-AGENTS block), templates/common/agents/pm.md (WORKSPACE-MANAGED block)
issues.description: Managed-block policy content ships to L0/L1 but the 11 Projects/co-* fleet inherits it only through scaffold or the manual project-resync runbook (last: 2026-09-16, 12 hand-created upgrade PRs). ADR-0080's authority text (2026-09-18) is the current unbackported instance. Remediation: ADR-0081 Decision 4 / T-20260918-004 — standing policy that policy-class L1 changes open a fleet backport ticket landing within one release cycle; ADR-0080 backport is the first instance.
